groups.activity: repeat the floor-21 boss after one weekly full clear
groups.meta: 12.5% per part; ~8 kills expected per specific part, ~18 for the full set
conditions: Clear the tower once per week to unlock the floor-21 hellevator; after that, repeat Roathe with no weekly limit.
The drop pool is shared with Uriel's frame parts — a run that 'gives nothing' for Vinquibus is usually an Uriel duplicate.
Descendia is a no-respawn mode: a squad wipe fails the floor.
Collect the 4 floating orbs around Roathe to cancel his invulnerable charge.
bonuses: Maphica also drops from containers on every floor plus fixed floor rewards (Infernums 2, 4, 9, 11, 16, 18) — a complete Vinquibus set costs 135 Maphica with zero RNG if you'd rather buy it outright.
Watch for a loot-room week (a Plunder/treasure floor placed early) for a fast Maphica haul.

groups.activity: kill and loot with a nuke/loot frame through the order phase and boss
groups.meta: materials come from kills and containers, not from completing orders
conditions: Completing Perita orders does not give these materials — orders pay Tauron Strike resources instead; ignore the order count and kill/break everything.
Perita bosses time out at 30 minutes; if your build can't kill it, the run is wasted.
Solo or duo beats a random four-player squad: order requirements scale with player count, so smaller squads see more drops per minute.
bonuses: Nekros (Desecrate/Despoil), Khora (Pilfering Strangledome) or Hydroid turn this into a passive side effect of the Uriel / Tauron Strike grind most players are already running.
Resourceful Retriever plus a resource booster and a resource drop-chance booster matter more than Steel Path.
Steel Path pays roughly 45% more of these materials per run and is optional.

disclosures.title: if you also want Uriel
disclosures.body: Uriel needs the same three materials from the same mission (1,975 Agnovidisc, 880 Laudavi, 350 Servoris) — farm both frames' worth in the same trip.

disclosures.title: weapon quirks
disclosures.body: It doesn't count as melee for Sortie melee-only conditions, and it can't be equipped in Duviri or Deep/Temporal Archimedea.
